assessment: Alpha.584 fixes actual stale self avatar skin on a valid current full ObjectUpdate TextureEntry with no genuine bake faces. Previously a prior provisional ObjectUpdate skin was kept even after all-placeholder/all-default TE withdrawal. The new strict TE parser differentiates valid explicit withdrawal from missing or malformed compressed headers, which do not destroy a good last source. Authenticated Low158 bake references remain authoritative per face. A scoped count of real withdrawals is shown in F3 and privacy-safe diagnostics, reset by agent/session/region. Native TE and actual Firestorm original body OpenGL framebuffer tests verify that references can be removed while the previous texture is still resident on GPU, yielding no old-skinned pixels and zero bake draws; later valid sources restore rendering. Real authenticated NexVerse skin/COF/outfit/attachments and simulator-confirmed WASD end-to-end still open/unverified, weighted 38.65 percent (rounded 39).
